visualCharacteristics.structure: centered person cards, 4-col grid: avatar, serif name, uppercase role line with pipe separators, row of 3 icon-only social links on a dark bar

contentPattern: cards: one row per person, 2 cells [image (portrait photo) | name as H3, occupation paragraph (e.g. 'Artist | Photographer | Traveler'), paragraph of 3 social links (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram; link text = network name, href from source)]
